_comment: Boot to AUX via a USER_DATA payload (supervisor.Last_Source = 7). This approach does not work: flashed 2026-09-14, the update ran and the application image was patched, but the payload landed in an uppercase SQLITE directory the application never opens, so Last_Source stayed 1 (see docs/VERIFICATION.md). Boot to AUX is done with application patches instead: builds/aux-boot.json. Kept as a record of the payload mechanism; it overwrites up_common.sqlite, which the car owns. `out` ends in a literal SMEG_PLUS_UPG because the updater reads the payload from the hard-coded /bd0/SMEG_PLUS_UPG/NAV/USER_DATA.
_value: Last_Source = 7, which C_MGR_SRC's own scheduler-position enum calls POS_AUX. Runtime SPY evidence separates this from raw SrcId: tuner logged Last_Source=1, SrcId=0xbc00 and Sched_Pos=1. The scheduler at 0x016957ec restores a source by matching node+0x18 (Sched_Pos) against Last_Source; raw SrcId is node+0x04. See docs/AUX_CHAIN.md.
_beacon: clock.Time_Zone is moved from 16 to 0 purely as a did-it-apply signal: harmless and revertible from the settings menu. Read the configured time zone in the clock settings, not the clock face (a GPS-slaved clock shows the right time regardless). On 2026-09-14 the time zone was unchanged, so the payload did not apply.
